# Every XML part-name family observed in real OOXML containers, one per line.
#
# Collected from 452 real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx produced by Word, PowerPoint, Excel and LibreOffice
# (399 of which the scanner reports it examined in full):
# 90 distinct families. Digit runs are normalised to N and producer-generated ids to ID, so this
# file is a list of SCHEMA CONVENTIONS and carries no content, no file names and nothing
# identifying from any document.
#
# TestEveryKnownOOXMLPartIsClassified requires each of these to be either INCLUDED or EXCLUDED by
# classifyPart, never unclassified. That is the gate #680 exists to install: part coverage has been
# decided by an allowlist seven times, and nothing ever asserted the list was complete. When a new
# Office release adds a part, add it here with the others and the guard makes someone decide whether
# it holds authored text — instead of it being silently unread, which under the sink rule means its
# values ship in cleartext.
#
# Adding a line is cheap. Leaving one out is the bug this file prevents.
